methodology.scope: Research only, task-owned declarations/configurations/native binaries, main checkout, no worktree. Production compiler and configuration unchanged.
methodology.timing: Timed compiler workloads ran sequentially. Desktop OS caches not flushed. First two plain samples use index-research.exe; third uses final-research.exe (only adds malformed-syntax fallback and a disabled binding switch). All three empty samples have identical effective semantics.
methodology.statistics: extendedDiagnostics has two explicit post-timing GCs; plain samples omit it. Memory is live heap after GC, not peak RSS.
methodology.trace: Single-checker trace with per-type-alias/interface duration and TotalInstantiationCount delta probes. Type-detail dumping disabled to avoid huge JSON. Trace timings are instrumented and not directly comparable with normal four-checker timings.
methodology.invalidFixtures: Initial defer-writable/defer-native-values probes had a declaration-slicing error. Their parse failures are recorded but excluded from optimization conclusions; corrected probes are in defer-fixed.
methodology.daemon: Uses isolated workspace marker and the installed RC6 SDK, structured local RPC, same Go PID across requests. Initial relative-path run failed to resolve JSX runtime in synthetic API programs and is excluded. Final fixture uses absolute paths; configured-project API separately verified inherited relative paths.
